text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to interpret and understand the visual world. By analyzing digital images and videos, systems can perform tasks like image recognition, identifying objects, people, or scenes. Object detection goes further, locating specific items within an image, such as finding a pedestrian on a busy street. These technologies have many applications, from sorting photos and improving medical scans to enabling security systems. Perhaps their most exciting use is in self-driving cars, where cameras and sensors help vehicles recognize road signs, avoid obstacles, and navigate safely. As this technology advances, it will continue to change how we interact with machines.
